topic: Spikeball(스파이크볼) — 샤크탱크에서 데이먼드와 50만 달러/20% 딜을 맺었지만 방송 전 무산, 그런데도 2019년 연 1,900만 달러 회사로 성장
form: 벤치 그대로 — 방송 원음(영어)+한국어 번역 자막 / 한국어 TTS 나레(반말 전언체)+자막, 번갈아

titles.rule: 벤치 틀 그대로: 위 검정 띠 2줄, 1줄 노랑·2줄 흰, 끝 '~?!'. 벤치 '홍수를 막을 수 있는 / 역대급 모래 주머니?!'와 겹치는 말 없음

f1.text: CNBC 클립 220.0~222.2초 투자자(화면 이름 자막 없음 — 이름 불명) 'a ball and a net'(vtt) — 받아쓰기 3/3 'a ball in a net' (앞 216.1 'you're asking me to pay 20 times your cash flow for')

f2.text: CNBC 199.9~203.6초 'so last year your total gross sales 1.4 million dollars' · 위키 'by 2013 the company was earning more than $1 million in annual revenue'

f3.text: CNBC 20.9~24.2초 창업자(5초 화면 이름 자막 'CHRIS RUDER · SPIKEBALL') 'very easy to learn, but really, really difficult to master'(받아쓰기 4/4)

f4.text: CNBC 53.0~70.0초 'serve the ball basically just by bouncing it off the net … has up to three hits … before they have to spike it back on the net' · 72~77초 'once the ball is in play there are no sides, all four players can run absolutely anywhere'

f5.text: CNBC 32.6~37.1초 창업자 'All you need is this ball, that net, one of these backpacks, and you can take it absolutely anywhere'(받아쓰기 2모델) · 72~77초 'there are no sides' · 공식 'Spikeball: Rally Anywhere' 6pC9CovZuBY 화면 = 눈밭(38~42초)·분수대 물 속(10~14초)에서 경기

f7.text: CNBC 174.9~178.3초 'what does one cost — 59.99 plus shipping' · 192.4~199.3초 'We've sold 29,000 units. And how much did they cost to make? A little over fourteen'(받아쓰기 2모델, 화자 2명)

f8.text: CNBC 234.8~237.2초 'I'll give you the 500,000' · 249.4~253.8초 'interested in, for 25% of the whole company' · 화면 자막 255~260초 'Daymond's offer: $500k for a 25% stake' · 275~281초 'Counter offer: $500k for a 15% stake' · 269.6~273.6초 창업자 'Would you consider 500k at 15%?'(받아쓰기 2모델) — 데이먼드 이름 = 화면 자막으로 확인

f9.text: CNBC 303.7~305.75초 '(is) one of those moments that you can lose it all'(받아쓰기 4/4, 화자 이름 자막 없음 — 자막·나레에 이름 안 씀)

f10.text: CNBC 313.3~314.2초 'call it even at 20' · 321.6초 'we're done' · 루퍼 'settling with John at 20%' · 위키 'Daymond John offered him $500,000 but wanted 20% … Ruder accepted'

f11.text: 위키 'the deal fell apart before the episode aired due to differences in strategy' · 루퍼(2017 포브스 인터뷰 인용) Ruder 'our deal was dead before the show aired'

f12.text: CNBC 324~334초 결말 글자 카드 'the deal did not close due to creative differences involving a Spider-Man Spikeball set, which CEO Chris Ruder was against. Ruder wanted Spikeball to be seen as a sport, not a toy.' · 루퍼 'John and Marvel Comics wanted to make a Spider-Man Spikeball set' · Ruder 'my fear was that people would think it was a toy'

f13.text: CNBC 329~334초 글자 카드 'As of 2019, the company brought in $19 million per year' · 루퍼 'As of 2019, Forbes reported that the company brings in $19 million per year'
